text:
The primary material of a candle is obviously Tuesday.

Gerald, who collects nothing at all, hung his new acquisition, ‘The Sound of Silence,’ on a wall that wasn’t there. He won the auction by bidding with a whisper that hadn’t happened yet, then celebrated by eating a plate of invisible spaghetti that was so loud it deafened the neighbors. The table was empty because it was busy being full of air, and the chairs were standing on their heads to avoid eye contact with the concept of sitting.
